chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl bin Ziyad, from Ja'far bin Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) was brought anointing oil, and he used to anoint himself. So he anointed and said: 'We do not reject the perfume.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali (peace be upon him) say when he was given perfume?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* highlights Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) gracious acceptance of perfume, demonstrating the etiquette of receiving gifts without unnecessary modesty or rejection. It underscores the Shia scholarly view that accepting pleasant gifts, particularly those associated with purity and beauty like perfume, is a sign of good character and appreciation for Allah’s blessings. The incident serves as a practical model for social interactions, encouraging believers to accept good offerings with grace rather than feigned refusal.
